profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Space & Defense | Cloud, AI/ML, Modeling & Simulation, Embedded | Digital Transformation
profile.summary:
Software engineer specializing in modeling & simulation, digital twins, and satellite ground systems. I build mission-critical and exploratory software for the space and defense domain using Python, Java, C, DIS, Docker, Kubernetes, and more. I’m passionate about architecting scalable systems and solving complex technical challenges that advance national security and space capabilities.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Engineering (Embedded Systems emphasis) from Brigham Young University and am currently pursuing an M.S. in Electrical & Computer Engineering from the University of Arizona. I love tackling fascinating problems, learning new technologies, and contributing to innovative systems that make a real impact.
